review_candidates.title: Product Manager, Campaign Pages
review_candidates.description: About Fundraise Up We’re Fundraise Up - a global fundraising platform built to make donating to nonprofits fast, seamless, and accessible to all. Every month, our technology powers tens of millions of dollars in donations across the globe. We focus on innovation that directly impacts results: faster load times, higher conversion rates, global payment support, and accessibility-first design. Our platform is trusted by many of the world’s leading nonprofits, including UNICEF, the Alzheimer’s Association, and a wide range of global NGOs. With a 4.9/5 rating across top software review platforms, we’re recognized not just for our impact - but for the quality of the product we deliver. About The Role A great campaign page doesn't just tell a story. It turns a visitor into a donor. Campaign Pages are where nonprofits launch campaigns, tell their stories and convert donors before checkout. They sit close to revenue, next to Checkout Modal and Elements in our Pre-Donation Experience. You will be the one person accountable for the Campaign Pages roadmap, quality and delivery. Your job is to make the product scalable, ready for enterprise customers and a clear driver of revenue, while traffic keeps growing and the product stays stable. Key Responsibilities Own the Campaign Pages strategy and a 6–12 month roadmap aligned with Product and Pre-Donation Experience priorities, and explain the reasoning behind decisions to leadership and stakeholders. Run continuous discovery using customer, GTM, Support, funnel and competitive signals. Separate one-off requests from systemic opportunities and validate problems before anything gets built. Drive delivery end to end with a dedicated Engineering Team Lead, Product Designer and Product Analyst: clear PRDs and edge cases, a backlog that is ready 2–3 sprints ahead, and launches with proper instrumentation. Own product health and enterprise readiness, covering conversion, page performance, reliability, publishing issues and support volume. Resolve deal-breakers and churn-risk requests within agreed SLAs. Partner with PM Growth on experiments, personalisation and ARPV initiatives. Prioritise incoming hypotheses against your own product data, and carry winning learnings across Checkout, Elements and Campaign Pages. Keep Engineering, Design, Analytics, GTM, Support and adjacent PMs aligned. Coordinate dependencies with Platform, Checkout, Gift Cart, Billing and Integrations when work touches shared systems. Make sure GTM, Support and CSMs know what is shipping, why it matters and how to explain it to customers. At Fundraise Up, AI is a default tool, not an experimental one. We expect every team member to actively use AI in their day-to-day work, identify where AI can change the shape of problems in their function, and grow their fluency as the tools evolve. In this role, that means using AI for research synthesis, spec drafting, analysis and communication, with your assumptions and sources made explicit. Skills And Qualifications 5+ years in Product Management or Product Ownership, ideally in B2B or enterprise SaaS, fundraising, marketing technology, e-commerce or conversion-focused products. Proven end-to-end ownership of a product area: roadmap, discovery, execution, launch and measurement. Strong delivery discipline: you write clear specs, cover edge cases and keep Engineering unblocked. Analytical rigour: you use funnels, metrics, support signals and qualitative feedback to prioritise. Systems thinking: you can see how a surface connects to checkout, payments, analytics, integrations and GTM workflows. A working understanding of growth and experimentation: how hypotheses are generated, prioritised and measured. Strong UX sensibility and a good working partnership with Design. Hands-on, everyday AI use in product work. Languages: Fluent Russian (required, as you’ll be working in a Russian-speaking team) and English at C1 level, both written and spoken. Nice to Have Experience with landing pages, campaign or website builders, CMS, donation or checkout flows. Hands-on experimentation, personalisation or conversion-optimisation work, including converting paid traffic after it reaches the landing page. Experience in nonprofit tech, fundraising, payments or marketing operations. Experience handling enterprise customer requests and GTM escalations. You'll Thrive Here If You… Own outcomes, not tasks, and don't wait for permission to fix what's broken. Can hold a wide context and still move quickly. Say no to a loud request when the data says something else matters more, and can explain why. Care as much about stability as about the next shiny experiment. Give and ask for candid feedback without ego. Get energy from aligning several teams around one shared goal. Keep sharpening your AI workflow because you want to, not because you were told to. Want your work to translate directly into more money reaching nonprofits. Please note that final compensation will be determined based on relevant experience, skills, qualifications, alignment with the role’s requirements and location. Gross Total Compensation €5.200—€5.700 EUR Perks & Benefits 22 days of vacation, 14 public holidays, and 5 fully paid sick days. Private health insurance for you and your family. Mental health support with therapy sessions for you and your partner. Sports reimbursement to help you stay active and feel your best. Fully remote work. Generous home office stipend to set up a comfortable, productive workspace. Coworking reimbursement for days when you'd rather work alongside other people. Internet and mobile phone allowance to cover your monthly connectivity costs. Annual professional development stipend to support your growth. English learning programs to help you communicate with confidence across our global team. Charitable giving program with company matching for your donations to registered non-profits. We are an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, national origin, disability, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law in the countries where we operate. ***Please note: All official correspondence from Fundraise Up will exclusively originate from the @fundraiseup.com domain. Exercise caution and ensure the authenticity of emails claiming to be from our company.***

review_candidates.title: Product Manager
review_candidates.description: About Incision Operating rooms are under pressure. Staffing shortages, increasing procedural complexity, and growing demand for care make it harder than ever for hospitals to keep perioperative teams prepared and supported. At Incision, we help hospitals improve how perioperative teams access knowledge, learn, and perform. Incision Assist helps surgical teams work with greater confidence and consistency by providing instant access to the information they need before and during procedures. Through MySPD and Academy, we support sterile processing and perioperative professionals with practical, accredited education that strengthens knowledge and performance across the surgical pathway. Today, hospitals in more than 20 countries use Incision to onboard staff faster, preserve critical knowledge, strengthen team collaboration, and improve operational performance. Working at Incision Impact & Quality: We strive for innovation and excellence in everything we do. Learning & Growing: We share knowledge, learn from one another, and continuously develop ourselves. Collaboration: We work together, support each other, and celebrate our successes as one team. Why we are hiring We are entering an exciting new phase of growth. As adoption of Incision Assist accelerates, we are investing heavily in product innovation, AI-powered knowledge delivery, and expanding our commercial presence in one of the world's most competitive healthcare technology markets. Your role This role reports to the Head of Product and combines strategic product management with hands-on product ownership. You will be responsible for deeply understanding user needs, defining and prioritising the roadmap, and collaborating with cross-functional teams to deliver high-impact product features. This role focuses on high-impact, customer-facing product strategy in the operating room, where reliability and workflow performance are critical. You will work closely with the Tech, Implementation, and Commercial teams to ensure Incision Assist continues to drive measurable outcomes in surgical performance and efficiency. Responsibilities Translate Incision’s vision into a clear product roadmap that reflects customer needs and business priorities. Act as the bridge between users, business, and technology, ensuring the right problems are being solved effectively. Collaborate closely with the Head of Product to align on strategic direction and portfolio priorities. Ensure high-quality requirements and clarity for the development team, supported by Tech leads, for day-to-day backlog execution. Engage with customers, clinicians, and hospital project teams to collect feedback, validate assumptions, and test new ideas. Partner with Sales, Implementation and Customer Success to ensure customer feedback is captured and acted on. Use data and insights to measure impact, guide prioritization, and continuously improve product performance. Collaborate cross-functionally to ensure all stakeholders are aligned on product plans, launches, and updates. Ensure domain strategy supports company-wide priorities and is aligned with the overall product portfolio. What You'll Bring 5+ years of experience in Product Management or Product Owner roles, ideally within SaaS or digital healthcare. Able to write clear, implementation-ready requirements (user stories with precise acceptance criteria, edge cases, and data/API considerations) and to engage credibly with engineers on architecture and trade-offs. Proven experience owning and delivering a product end-to-end in an Agile environment. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with an ability to translate complex workflows into elegant product solutions. Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills - comfortable working with clinical, technical, and business teams. Passionate about improving healthcare performance and helping surgical teams deliver better patient outcomes. Highly organized, proactive, and adaptable: able to balance strategic thinking with hands-on execution. Experience within healthcare technology or healthcare services is strongly preferred. What We Offer The opportunity to make a meaningful impact on the future of healthcare. Competitive compensation. Professional development opportunities, with room for continuous learning, training, and career growth. A role within a fast-growing international healthtech scale-up. Collaboration with an ambitious international team working at the intersection of healthcare, technology, and education. A pension plan, commuting allowance, and access to OpenUp. Regular team activities, knowledge-sharing sessions, and social events. A modern workplace, including a laptop and home office equipment. A diverse and inclusive workplace where everyone is valued and empowered to thrive. Incision is a healthtech company dedicated to helping surgical teams perform at their best. We provide smart, user-friendly tools that give perioperative and sterile processing professionals access to the knowledge they need—anytime, anywhere. Our solutions are used in hospitals and training programs across more than 50 countries, helping improve surgical workflows, reduce stress, and support better outcomes for patients and teams alike. Founded by healthcare professionals, we’re driven by one mission: to support the people who care for others.

review_candidates.title: Plumbing Supervisor
review_candidates.description: The Plumbing Supervisor will be based at based at Amentum sites in US Embassy, Caracas supporting DiPSS Venezuela BLS contract in support of the US. Department of State. This position will be responsible for performing plumbing requirements on O&M, small construction, remodeling, or renovation projects. This position provides supervision, leadership, oversight, and associated responsibilities to the plumbing team and performs a variety of plumbing trade functions such as the installation, maintenance, or repair of equipment. The Plumbing Supervisor will report to the Chief Engineer. The duties and responsibilities listed below are representative of the nature and level of work assigned and are not necessarily all inclusive. DUTIES: Responsible for maintaining a safe workplace and ensuring that safety is the highest priority in the workplace. Comply with all Environmental Health & Safety and Quality Assurance requirements and goals. Provide information and materials to these divisions as necessary to ensure adequate and legal documentation. Provide supervision, leadership, oversight, and associated responsibilities for the day-to-day operation and maintenance for all plumbing systems for both exterior and interior in multiple buildings, living quarters, including the kitchen facility. The scope of work to include but not limited to all preventive maintenance, repairs, and new installations per applicable codes and industry standards as follows: All water systems with associated pressure pumps, piping, fittings, valves, storage tanks, electric water heaters, and sump pumps. Plumbing fixtures: sinks, showers, tubs, toilets, faucets, and kitchen equipment. All sewer and drain systems with associated piping, fittings, lift stations, grease traps and roof drains and drain cleaning. Fuel piping for power generators. Read blueprints, drawings, and specifications. Understand the scheduling sequence. Inspect structures to ascertain obstruction that would compromise the structure integrity of the building to be avoided. Coordinate with other trades to avoid conflict between the plumbing and other work. Lay out all plumbing systems to be straight, plumb and on grade as needed. For remodeling, be able to be determined possible obstructions before drilling holes in finished walls, floors, or ceilings. Responsible for the daily work schedules. Track preventive maintenance and make changes as needed. Plan and estimate labor and materials for future projects. Order materials and equipment needed for projects. Track and order material and equipment for daily operations. Maintain accurate records for safety meetings, work hours, work orders, training, and inventory of shop stock materials, tools, and equipment. Conduct daily safety meetings and ensure all workers follow safety procedures and wear appropriate PPE. Prepare appropriate paperwork for digging and confine space permits and as needed Job Hazardous Analyst forms (JHA). Work and coordinate with plumbing foreman and plumbing leads to delegate responsibilities so there is cross over training to account for days off and R&R. Perform additional duties and projects as assigned. REQUIRED: Minimum Acceptable Experience Level: Two (2) years’ experience as a Master Plumber, ten (10) years’ experience as a Journeyman Plumber or meet any state licensing board requirements for a Master Plumber license. Three (3) years’ supervisory experience in the plumbing trade. Experience working with CPVC, PVC, PEX, Copper, Galvanized, Steel and Brass pipe and fittings. Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities: Expert knowledge of all plumbing installations and repairs, to include but not limited to plumbing fixtures and faucets, water and drain systems, water pumps, sump pumps, sewage lift stations, grease traps, and fuel piping. Ability to use equipment and tools of the trade such as drills, saws, grinders, threading equipment, drain cleaning equipment, portable pumps and air compressors. Knowledge of principles and processes involved in supporting plumbing functions at an overseas facility. Demonstrated ability to provide excellent customer services. Ability to work in a fast-paced environment that requires handling multiple tasks at a given time and rapidly adapting to changing priorities and schedules. Cross-cultural sensitivity with an international perspective. Excellent organizational and time management skills. Computer skills, specifically in Microsoft Word and Excel. Ability to become an active and functioning member of a team. Ability to be innovative and be an agent for change. Expert communication skills to facilitate and disseminate information. Education: A high school diploma or GED. Licenses and Certifications: Valid drivers’ license from Home of Record. Current Master Plumber license (must hold prior to hire date or able to obtain a Master Plumber license within 180 days employment). Certification in backflow prevention and cross-connection control. Security Vetting: Must be able to obtain and maintain a Secret US Government Clearance. Note: US Citizenship is required to obtain Secret Clearance. Language Skills: Satisfactory English proficiency to meet job requirements and to adhere and comply with safety, health, and security measures. Medical: Successfully complete and pass the medical and dental examinations as required by Amentum and our customer for deployment to Venezuela. Must maintain physical and dental requirements for duration of deployment. DESIRED: Previous out of home country experience and previous work experience in harsh environmental conditions are a plus. Experience working with Amentum. Other Responsibilities Safety - Amentum enforces a safety culture whereby all employees have the responsibility for continuously developing and maintaining a safe work environment. As appropriate, each employee is responsible for completing all training requirements and fulfilling all self-aid/buddy aid responsibilities, participating in emergency response tasks, and serving on safety committees and teams. Quality - Quality is the foundation for the management of our business and the keystone to our goal of customer satisfaction. It is our policy to consistently provide services that meet customer expectations. Accordingly, each employee must conform to the Amentum Quality Policy and carry out job activities in compliance with applicable Amentum Quality System documents and customer contracts. Each employee must read and understand his/her Quality Management and Customer Satisfaction responsibilities. Procedure Compliance - Each employee must read, understand, and implement the general and specific operational, safety, quality and environmental requirements of all plans, procedures and policies pertaining to job. Working as part of a cross functional team, you deliver the RDQ activities required to complete Packaging Design and Packaging Deployment for Innovation/Growth projects and productivity projects across multiple geographies with an emphasis on delivering the desired consumer experience. How You Will Contribute With the support and guidance of a manager, you will organize and execute projects in line with RDQ, marketing and manufacturing requirements, effectively communicating status and risks. You will plan and conduct activities to generate appropriate packaging information, using sampling and supplier management, and pilot plant and factory trials in accordance with good manufacturing practice and HACCP requirements. In this role, you will plan and conduct process development activities (e.g. packaging design and specifications, packaging scale up, commissioning etc.) and help with planning and the effective use of resources, including the use of external agencies. You will also create technical reports, which will require your skills in analysis and interpretation of results that will lead to conclusions and recommendations; create and maintain accurate packaging specifications; and create intellectual property to drive our competitive advantage. What You Will Bring A desire to drive your future and accelerate your career. You will bring experience and knowledge in: Working on teams and independently with the guidance of a manager Prioritizing and managing activities Identifying problems proactively and creating and implementing solutions independently Applying fundamental technical understanding to interpret and analyze data to reach clear conclusions Communicating effectively verbally and in writing, including technical writing Putting the consumer at the heart of development activities Technical curiosity and a collaborative mindset More About This Role What you need to know about this position: This person is an experienced R&D packaging professional who can lead packaging development projects independently and provide packaging development, technical and expertise support. Acts as a business partner and work with business team (Marketing for example) to provide packaging solutions to continue drive business growth. This position is accountable for overall packaging development for JANZ BU. Packaging development may cover NPD programs, Promotion, gifting, productivity, quality improvement and technical support. Packaging technology development may include new packaging material, new packaging function, new packing format and new packing engineering introduction or reformulate current ones. This position requires a detailed understanding of packaging development process, sustainability and depth knowledge of packaging enabling technologies to make a significant contribution to project objective and outcomes. Furthermore, consumer-oriented sense is very important during development, basic business knowledge is also necessary for this position. What extra ingredients you will bring: Manage and deliver new packaging development projects for Japan Australia New Zealand BU or within AMEA market which may include NPD, promotion, gifting, productivity on time and on quality. Work as a business partner, provide technical support to business. Active participant in developing, recommending, planning and delivery in line with business process. Work with global team for new technology application locally. Other tasks assigned by line manager. Internal relationships with cross-function: Marketing, Consumer Insight, PCM, ISC, Procurement, R&D product team, CS, Quality, Global RD External relationships with suppliers, testing and prototyping labs, and universities. Education / Certifications: Bachelor's or master's degree in Packaging Engineering, Food Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Material science Job specific requirements: Strong communicator, and remote stakeholder management. At least 5-7 years’ experience in packaging development. Strong project management background. Able to manage multiple assignments and tasks concurrently and meet deadline. Experience in food industry and FMCG industry is preferred. Good inter-personal skill. Good command of English. Experience on digital development tools e.g Cape Pack, SAP PLM, SAP MDG is preferred. Experience on digital prototyping tools is a plus. Travel requirements: As per the business need. Work schedule: Full-Time No Relocation support available Business Unit Summary Mondelēz International in the Middle East, North Africa and Pakistan serves the Middle East and Africa markets as well as Australia, New Zealand, the UK and Canada. Headquartered in Dubai, UAE, we have more than 2600 employees working across seven plants and six commercial offices; we make, bake, sell and deliver our products to customers. We are market leaders in key snacking categories with iconic global and local brands including Cadbury Dairy Milk chocolate, Milka, Oreo and belVita biscuits, Barni Cakes,Tang powdered beverage, Chiclets and Trident gum and Halls candy.
